snippet.title: ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist and Follow NOW on Steam and Itch.io!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727600/All_the_Promised_Burn__An_Yssaia_Game/?beta=0
Itch.io: https://amaiguri.itch.io/allthepromisedburn

"All promised heroes burn. Who are they now?"

In war-torn world of fated heroes, flawed philosophies, and bunny-eared Demons, a burned assassin girl must find a new life purpose.

All the Promised Burn: An Yssaia Game is a hand-drawn Knowledge-based RPG. Navigate an assassin through her delicate, brutal world after the War annexed her homeland. Collect artifacts to increase your knowledge and unlock more of the dark corners of the world and your heart.
